name: gh-repo-config
description: Org-wide repo-configuration converger — deterministic core consumed as an immutable GitHub Release.

scripts.lint: shellcheck assets/*.sh scripts/*.sh template/scripts/*.sh && for f in assets/*.sh scripts/*.sh template/scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && grep -l --null '^on:' assets/*.yml | xargs -0 actionlint -shellcheck= .github/workflows/*.yml && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && oxlint --deny-warnings && yamllint . && git ls-files -z '*.json' | xargs -0 jsonlint --quiet && tombi lint && oxfmt --check && markdownlint-cli2
